[CR CR1058r1 for 38.473] Reason for change: Extended Additional Path List, TRP Rx TEG ID, and TRP Rx Timing Error Margin are IEs added to the UL RTOA Measurement IE in R17. However, in ASN.1 of TS 38.473, these three IEs, which should have been added to the extension of UL-RTOA-Measurement-ExtIEs, are mistakenly added into the UL-RTOA-MeasurementItem-ExtIEs. Summary of change: Remove the three IEs Extended Additional Path List, TRP Rx TEG ID, and TRP Rx Timing Error Margin from the UL-RTOA-MeasurementItem-ExtIEs. Add them into the UL-RTOA-Measurement-ExtIEs. Impact analysis: Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has an impact on the protocol as it moves some IEs from UL-RTOA-MeasurementItem-ExtIEs to UL-RTOA-Measurement-ExtIEs.
